name: New York Comic Con
notes: 2027 dates were not on ReedPop's site as of 2026-10-10, so Oct 7-10 and a return to the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center (coords are the recent Javits pin) are estimated from the 2025-2026 Thursday-Sunday pattern; the 2026 Cosplay Central Crown Championships qualifier published a $1,000 first-place purse, and the 2026 all-in 4-day badge ran about $321 early and $371 later.

name: PAX East
venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
notes: ReedPop and Penny Arcade announced April 22-25, 2027 at the Menino center on March 29, 2026; a 2026 weekend badge listed at $280 with fees, while a large cash masquerade purse was not published and the $150 grand-prize figure is an estimate for the smaller judged costume contests and meetups PAX East has run.

name: Anime NYC
notes: The official site lists August 26-29, 2027 at the Javits Center (445 11th Ave) and the 2026 masquerade on the Main Stage awarded Best in Show through beginner divisions without publishing dollar amounts, so the $500 grand prize is an estimate; the 2026 4-day badge was about $175 before tax and about $205 all-in.

name: Super MAGFest
notes: MAGFest lists January 7-10, 2027 at the Gaylord (201 Waterfront St) with a $145 opening badge, and its Super Cosplay Contest and craftsmanship contest award trophies plus mpoints rather than published cash, so $100 is an estimated mpoints-equivalent grand prize and the $250 room rate is estimated from the same hotel's published February 2027 Katsucon block.

name: Katsucon
notes: Katsucon's site sets February 12-14, 2027 at the Gaylord, a $90 last-chance full membership after the $80 early-bird window, and a $255-per-night king or double block before resort fee and tax, while the 2027 masquerade rules (registration Nov 27, 2026-Jan 2, 2027) list Best in Show without a cash amount so $300 is an estimate.

name: Anime Expo
notes: SPJA announced a return to the Los Angeles Convention Center on July 2-5, 2027, the masquerade page lists a $5,000 Best in Show (plus $2,000 Masters and Intermediate), the 2026 4-day credential was $175 in the April tier, and the housing page listed JW Marriott L.A. LIVE from $244 a night.

name: San Diego Comic-Con
notes: Comic-Con International lists July 22-25, 2027 at the San Diego Convention Center with Preview Night on July 21, 2027 adult badges at $88 Thursday-Saturday and $67 Sunday plus a $15 handling fee (about $346 for four days), and the 2026 masquerade's largest published cash award was Frank & Son's $1,000 audience favorite while Best in Show was a trophy plus up to five 2027 4-day badges.

name: Dragon Con
venue: Downtown Atlanta host hotels and AmericasMart
notes: Dragon Con and Georgia Public Broadcasting set the 2027 Labor Day run as September 2-6 across the downtown host hotels and AmericasMart, the contests page lists a $500 Best in Show check plus a three-night host-hotel stay, the 2026 full membership finished at $180 while 2027 was in a $125 early tier after September 22, 2026, and the 2026 Marriott Marquis single rate shown was $278.

name: FAN EXPO Canada
notes: FAN EXPO HQ lists August 26-29, 2027 at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, the 2026 four-day pass was CAD $139 (about USD 100 at a 0.72 rate; 2027 prices were not on sale yet), Masters of Cosplay Best in Show advances to the MegaCon Orlando grand final rather than a published Toronto cash purse so $500 is an estimate, and the $260 hotel rate is an estimated downtown weekend rate.

name: Emerald City Comic Con
notes: ReedPop's FAQ sets March 4-7, 2027 in the Seattle Convention Center Summit and Arch buildings with a 4-day ticket at $166.94 including tax and fees, the Cosplay Central Crown Championships regional first prize matched the circuit's published $1,000 (a separate 2026 showcase listed only $250 Best in Show), and $250 a night is an estimated downtown hotel rate.
